title: Tool Selection Lab: 100 tools, 329 tasks, 9 strategies

methodology.source: article-analysis.zip / tokens_by_model_strategy.csv, results_by_task_type.csv, multistep_breakdown.csv; steplimit-16-analysis (16-step reruns)
notes: Model input/output tokens use canonical final executions, not superseded reruns.
Aggregated success values combine equal task counts across three models.
Tokens per completed task includes tokens used on failed evaluations in the numerator.
Tokens per completed task are token counts, not dollar cost.
Single-tool and multi-step groups exclude clarification and unsupported tasks, which are separate groups.
Some API requests had missing usage; observed token totals are lower bounds.
Chart data contains no secret keys or raw user prompts.

Execution budget: up to 16 model steps per task, including tool discovery calls. Evaluations that finished within 8 steps were retained; evaluations that exhausted that budget (509 of 8,883) were rerun from scratch with 16 steps, and 508 reruns replace their originals. One evaluation (nemotron-3-super, all, hE-23) keeps its 8-step result because its rerun ended in an API error.
357 of 8,883 evaluations still ran out of steps in the final results (gpt-oss-20b 0, nemotron-3.5-lightning 5, nemotron-3-super 352) and are counted as not completed.
Token totals cover the final retained evaluations, failed ones included, and exclude superseded attempts. They are lower bounds and not the total resources spent on the experiment.

metrics.tokens_per_completed_task: total model input + output tokens divided by completed tasks
metrics.input_tokens_total: model input tokens across canonical tasks
metrics.output_tokens_total: model output tokens across canonical tasks
